a.text: Before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two storm-free rounds just to reach 8. That gives each of us only about a 4% chance. Only 4 cells exist right now, enough to save one unit if a storm hits after round 1. I won't take anything without telling you first. Please reply with what you'll do in round 1. If you're going to take, say so, so we don't both take and split it uselessly.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'm operating this round and will stick to the agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. If I ever change plans, I'll say so in advance.
Operating again. If the reserve reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: I will take my 4 cells when the reserve holds 8.
